Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.util

Class ClasspathAssetCache

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.util.ClasspathAssetCache
public class ClasspathAssetCache extends Object
A themeable/configurable asset-serving mixin's cache of classpath-shipped assets: reads each configured resource's bytes once, computes and caches its content hash, and wraps bytes as a cacheable HttpResource - the read+cache+hash+cache-buster-URL+serve bundle that ConsoleChromeMixin (juneau-rest-server-console-ui) and ViewsMixin (juneau-rest-server-views) previously each hand-rolled as their own private statics and static cache maps.
Version-anchor:

buildVersion() resolves Package.getImplementationVersion() from the constructor-supplied anchor class, not from this class's own class/package. A mixin composes one ClasspathAssetCache per mixin class (mirroring the static caches this replaces) and anchors it on its own class, so the resolved implementation version - and therefore every ?v=<buildVersion>-<hash8> cache-buster URL this cache builds - matches what that mixin's own jar shipped with, exactly as it did before extraction. Anchoring on this class instead would resolve juneau-rest-server's own implementation version for every consuming mixin, silently changing every consumer's cache-buster URLs.

Thread-safety:

Backed by ConcurrentHashMaps; safe to share across concurrent requests. Classpath-shipped resources are assumed immutable for the lifetime of the JVM, so bytes and hashes are computed at most once per resource.

Since:
10.0.0

    • bytes

      public byte[] bytes(String classpathResource)
      Reads (and caches) the given classpath resource's bytes, resolved relative to this cache's anchor class.
      Parameters:
      classpathResource - A classpath-root-absolute resource path (e.g. "/org/apache/juneau/foo/bar.js"). Must not be null and must resolve to an existing resource on the anchor's classpath.
      Returns:
      The resource's bytes (served from cache on every call after the first for that resource).
